description: Deploy Contract Gate rule set v2.0: whitelist / daily & per-function deploy caps / interval / count semantics / storage / atomic state / secret precheck / override / undo / audit link (all computable, single source of truth).
contract_source: Abstract deploy contract (configurable): max 6 deploys per day, max 3 deploys per function per day, minimum 30s interval between deploys; whitelist is configurable; an override requires the deploy owner's written verbatim release quoted into the log.

counting.daily_window_note: The current day window uses Asia/Shanghai (+08:00, no DST); denied events do not consume quota, only ALLOW events count

state.log_sha_note: State records a content fingerprint (log_sha) of deploy_log; if an external append desyncs the fingerprint, counts are replayed from the log

self_deploy_policy: The host system's own function deploys go through the same gate (only whitelisted functions may deploy, no exception)

override_policy.method: Deploy owner provides a written verbatim release quote in chat (quoted into the log verbatim, no secondary confirmation button)
override_policy.log: The verbatim quote is auto-appended to the deploy log note column
override_policy.scope: The quote must contain the target function name (scope binding); valid for that single deploy only, not carried over
override_policy.consumption: Consumed once by sha256(first 16 chars) of the verbatim quote; not carried to another function / next day / re-submit
override_policy.bypass: Only bypasses daily<=6 / per-function<=3 / interval>=30s; cannot bypass whitelist or secret precheck

undo.note: Audit logs are append-only by default; undo only covers user-initiated report cleanup, and override-quote logs are not subject to undo

event_contract.redaction: Secret precheck transmits verdict only (clean/found + rule_id), zero secret values; reports contain zero sensitive values
